svg.title: Goals by four roles
svg.desc: Target design documentation. English diagram labels; not implemented or tested on an application. Sources are recorded in metadata.

g.text: Representative goals; five detailed views cover all 51 use cases. IT Manager means Head of IT.
Own tickets/confirmation/acceptance; accessible KB sources only.
IT reviews/sends; draft is not a comment
Perform specialist work and record results; background coordination does not change performer rights.
Set policies; supervise, lock/intervene, approve exceptions. No Team Lead tier.
Admin; no secrets or others' chats
Account/settings administration; AI cannot borrow Admin rights to create users.
Source: UC catalog · Permissions matrix · BR-01–22
Association means participation, not sequence • AI and scheduler are internal
